activity.text: Pushed main + testing to GitHub; token covers issues/PRs/actions/deployments/releases
Organizer deck built (12 slides, 3 clips) in docs/deck/out; GitHub remote added, main merged with origin, ready to push
Impeccable 4.4.0 rerun: 61 → 3 findings (3 intentional); headings, 11px floor, save bar
Score cards: saved/unsaved/edit states with Edit + Cancel; fixed fetch from share-link pages
Players page: levels 1–7 per player with dated history, balance-by-level pairing; Spanish added as fourth language

Tested the tablet view on a Samsung Galaxy Tab 2 in real Chrome 71 and Firefox 68 at every Tab 2 viewport: fixed text that never grew in old engines, run-together labels, a header that wrapped, names cut unseen; per-match Save misfired on old engines (fixed). test/tab2/run.sh re-runs it.

Tablet view rebuilt as a fit-to-screen grid: a row per pair, a column per round, court in each cell; now/next columns highlighted. 16 pairs x 12 rounds x 8 courts fits an iPad in both orientations; refreshes in place, keeps the screen awake.

Saves now morph the page instead of replacing it: score entry keeps focus, caret and scroll (viewport shift 52px -> 0). Language toggle returns to the page it was pressed on and morphs the header too.

Venues and the single club merged into one Clubs list (Settings → Clubs; home picked there or on the Overview). Saves swap the page in place via fetch. Import survives WhatsApp copy prefixes; time line read in every spelling. Active night pinned or read off the calendar.

Teams tab is a pairs board before the draw: seats + unpaired tray, pointer-event drag, tap-to-swap, keyboard; "Pair up the rest at random" (F/M-aware on mixed), "Reshuffle everyone"; Save writes partners both ways. 30/30 tests.

Paste-and-review import of the club message: parser in src/import.js reads date, time window → duration, level, venue, numbered roster with (dupla) pairs; the new-tournament form fills in, Create signs everyone up. 27/27 tests.

Console restyled to Padel Buddy (palette + mark). Tournament page is four tabs (Board/Teams/Rounds/Table), Rounds is one form with Save all + per-match Save; empty boxes no longer coerce to 0-0. Settings tabbed too.

Round messages and Telegram. One message per round (court by court, who rests, one line per pair for where to go next) is posted to every group when the previous round's last score lands. src/messaging/ is a bus over a live Telegram channel and the WhatsApp draft outbox. TV view now shows the round actually being played. 24/24 tests.
Score entry rebuilt: each match is a form with one line per team and that team's score box on it; Save spans both. Old table column strings removed.

Board message rebuilt as a courts x 4 slot list driven by tournament settings; full EN/PT layer (src/i18n.js) across console, bot and errors; drop-out policy editable in both languages. 17/17 tests pass.
Added src/levels.js and src/dates.js, migrated tournaments to ISO date + time, rebuilt the console mobile-first, seeded Padel Tribe. 10/10 parser tests pass.

headline: Clubhouse tablet verified on a Galaxy Tab 2
summary: The tablet view now sizes itself in the page (largest text that fits, by bisection), so a 2018 browser gets the same result as a new one: all 26 Galaxy Tab 2 cases fit in real Chrome 71 and Firefox 68, with no clipping and no cut names; the club's 6-pair night reads at 25px on the 7-inch and 31px on
next: Install Firefox on the club's Tab 2, open /t/<id>/tv, tap for full screen; or switch Cloudflare's edge CA to Google Trust Services so Chrome works too
